"""Open the live showcase in a fresh headless Chrome profile, run the README try-it steps,
and check the link-preview tags and the deployed preview image."""
import hashlib, json, os, struct, sys, tempfile, time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait

repo = Path(sys.argv[1]); out = Path(sys.argv[2])
URL = "https://lejie710.github.io/object-lens/"
os.environ.update(SE_CACHE_PATH=str(repo / ".local" / "selenium"), SE_OFFLINE="true", SE_AVOID_STATS="true")


def fetch(path):
    try:
        with urlopen(Request(URL + path, headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}), timeout=30) as response:
            return response.status, response.headers.get("Content-Type"), response.read()
    except HTTPError as error:
        return error.code, error.headers.get("Content-Type"), b""


class Meta(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.tags = {}
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == "meta" and ("property" in attrs or "name" in attrs):
            kind = "property" if "property" in attrs else "name"
            self.tags[attrs[kind]] = {"attribute": kind, "content": attrs.get("content")}


report = {"evidence_type": "live GitHub Pages showcase opened in a fresh headless Chrome profile; README try-it steps; link-preview tags and image",
          "url": URL, "checked_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "passed": False}
status, ctype, html = fetch("")
parser = Meta(); parser.feed(html.decode("utf-8"))
local = parser.__class__(); local.feed((repo / "dist" / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
report["page_status"] = status
report["preview_tags"] = {k: v for k, v in parser.tags.items() if k.startswith(("og:", "twitter:"))}
report["preview_tags_match_repository_index_html"] = report["preview_tags"] == {k: v for k, v in local.tags.items() if k.startswith(("og:", "twitter:"))}
image_url = parser.tags["og:image"]["content"]
assert image_url.startswith(URL)
istatus, itype, image = fetch(image_url[len(URL):])
committed = (repo / "dist" / "social-preview.png").read_bytes()
report["preview_image"] = {"url": image_url, "status": istatus, "content_type": itype, "bytes": len(image),
                           "sha256": hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest(),
                           "dimensions": list(struct.unpack(">II", image[16:24])) if image[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" else None,
                           "identical_to_repository_file": image == committed}
for path in ["test-worker.js", "docs/DESIGN.md", "credits.html"]:
    report[f"status_{path}"] = fetch(path)[0]
_, _, config = fetch("runtime-config.json")
report["runtime_config_testMode"] = json.loads(config)["testMode"]

downloads = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ol-showcase-dl-"))
options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
for flag in ["--headless=new", "--window-size=1440,1000", "--no-first-run", "--no-default-browser-check",
             f"--user-data-dir={tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='ol-showcase-profile-')}"]:
    options.add_argument(flag)
options.set_capability("goog:loggingPrefs", {"browser": "ALL"})
driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=options)
try:
    driver.execute_cdp_cmd("Browser.setDownloadBehavior", {"behavior": "allow", "downloadPath": str(downloads)})
    report["browser_version"] = driver.capabilities.get("browserVersion")
    state = lambda: driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, "html").get_attribute("data-state")
    rows = lambda: [[r.get_attribute("data-label"), round(float(r.get_attribute("data-score")), 3)] for r in driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, ".result-row")]
    start = time.perf_counter(); driver.get(URL)
    WebDriverWait(driver, 180, 0.2).until(lambda d: state() in {"ready", "error"})
    report["ready_seconds_including_model_download"] = round(time.perf_counter() - start, 1)
    report["state_after_load"] = state()
    start = time.perf_counter(); driver.find_element(By.ID, "try-sample").click()
    WebDriverWait(driver, 120, 0.2).until(lambda d: state() in {"complete", "empty", "error"})
    report["sample_seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - start, 1)
    report["predictions_at_0_50"] = rows()
    driver.execute_script("const e=document.getElementById('minimum-score');e.value='0.80';e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));")
    report["predictions_at_0_80"] = rows()
    driver.find_element(By.ID, "save-result").click()
    files = WebDriverWait(driver, 30).until(lambda d: [p for p in downloads.glob("*.png")] if not list(downloads.glob("*.crdownload")) else [])
    payload = files[0].read_bytes()
    report["saved_png"] = {"name": files[0].name, "width": struct.unpack(">II", payload[16:24])[0], "height": struct.unpack(">II", payload[16:24])[1]}
    driver.execute_script("const e=document.getElementById('minimum-score');e.value='0.50';e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));")
    report["predictions_restored"] = rows()
    report["console_errors"] = [e["message"] for e in driver.get_log("browser") if e["level"] == "SEVERE"]
finally:
    driver.quit()
report["passed"] = (report["page_status"] == 200 and report["state_after_load"] == "ready"
                    and report["preview_tags_match_repository_index_html"]
                    and report["preview_image"]["status"] == 200 and report["preview_image"]["identical_to_repository_file"]
                    and report["status_test-worker.js"] == 404 and report["status_docs/DESIGN.md"] == 404
                    and report["runtime_config_testMode"] is False and report["saved_png"]["width"] == 600
                    and report["predictions_restored"] == report["predictions_at_0_50"])
report["limits"] = ["One visit from one Windows laptop in headless Chrome; not a load test, not a mobile or other-browser check.",
                    "Ready time depends on the network and on GitHub Pages caching; it is one observation.",
                    "Checks the tags and image LinkedIn reads; how LinkedIn renders the card is shown only by its Post Inspector."]
report["check_source"] = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert not out.exists()
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "check_source"}, indent=1)[:3000])

import hashlib, json, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
repo = Path(sys.argv[1]); URL = "https://lejie710.github.io/object-lens/"
package = json.loads((repo / "docs/evidence/v1-0-3-package.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
rows = []
for item in package["files"]:
    try:
        with urlopen(Request(URL + item["path"], headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}), timeout=120) as r:
            body = r.read(); status = r.status
    except HTTPError as e:
        body, status = b"", e.code
    rows.append({"path": item["path"], "status": status, "bytes": len(body),
                 "matches_package_record": status == 200 and len(body) == item["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() == item["sha256"]})
result = {"checked_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
          "package_record": "docs/evidence/v1-0-3-package.json", "package_content_id": package["content_id"],
          "files_checked": len(rows), "files_matching": sum(r["matches_package_record"] for r in rows),
          "mismatches": [r for r in rows if not r["matches_package_record"]]}
path = repo / "docs/evidence/showcase-check.json"
record = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
record["deployed_files_against_package_record"] = result
record["passed"] = record["passed"] and result["files_matching"] == result["files_checked"]
src = record.pop("check_source"); record["check_source"] = src
record["package_check_source"] = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
print(json.dumps(result, indent=1)); print("passed", record["passed"])
